title: Import Class Member – CSV Row References Archived Lesson Allocation – Row Imports as Successful with Validation Skipped, Class Member Never Synced to BO
description: Feature Impact (Class Assignment / Master Queue), negative/gap case - Decision Table: contrasts with the existing "Invalid CSV Data" baseline (case 10555, which expects row-level error messages for non-existent IDs or missing fields): a CSV row pointing at a valid but archived Lesson Allocation is not treated as invalid at all. ClassMemberValidator silently skips all its checks for a row whose Lesson Allocation is archived (it is absent from the validator's lookup map), so even a row with an out-of-range Effective Start Date would pass silently in this state. The import reports success, but the resulting Class Member is immediately hidden by the Is_Archived__c formula and is excluded from AssignClassMemberBatchable's sync, so it never reaches BO.
preconditions:
- Student A's Lesson Allocation for Math 101 has been archived (Archived_At__c populated) after its Student Package Order was fully removed.
- Class A exists for Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ. A CSV file is prepared with one row: Student A's archived Lesson Allocation Id, Class A, Effective Start Date = today.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff uploads the CSV via the Import Class Member flow"
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens the created Class Member record directly by record Id"
3. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Student Detail -> Courses tab on BO"
4. "HQ or CM Staff checks whether any Student Session was created for Student A on Class A's lessons"
steps_result:
1. "The import completes with no row-level error for Student A's row - unlike the "Invalid CSV Data" baseline (case 10555), an archived-LA row is not flagged as invalid"
2. "The Class Member record exists, tied to the archived Lesson Allocation, with no validation error ever raised against it"
3. "Class A does NOT appear as Student A's class on BO"
4. "No Student Session is created for Student A on any Class A lesson"
steps_data:
1. "CSV row: Lesson Allocation Id = Student A's archived LA, Class = Class A, Effective Start Date = today"
2. "ClassMemberValidator.retrieveData's lessonAllocationMap excludes archived LAs (Archived_At__c = NULL filter) -> validateClassMember's containsKey check is false -> all checks silently skipped"
3. "Student A's Class Member Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) immediately after creation"
4. "AssignClassMemberBatchable.doStart excludes the archived LA (Archived_At__c = NULL filter) -> the sync job never processes this Class Member"

title: Import Class Member – Student Auto-Assigned via CSV Import – Lesson Allocation Archived – Hidden from Lesson; Restored – Shown Again
description: Feature Impact (Class Assignment / Master Queue) - Decision Table: a student successfully auto-assigned to a Class's lessons via the "Import Class Member" CSV flow (case 10532 baseline, LA active at import time) disappears from that Class's lesson Student Sessions once their Lesson Allocation is later archived, and reappears on the same record once the Lesson Allocation is restored - same pattern already locked in for the Location Course "Active Student" assign flow (suite 1291, case "Location Course – Class Assigned to Student"), now confirmed for the CSV import path too, since both paths share the same ClassMemberTrigger -> AssignClassMemberBatchable sync mechanism.
preconditions:
- Student A has an active Lesson Allocation for Math 101 at Location Tokyo HQ (Archived_At__c blank).
- HQ or CM Staff has imported a CSV assigning Class A to Student A (Effective Start Date = today) via the Import Class Member flow; the Class Member record was created successfully, and a lesson for Class A exists today - Student A currently appears in that lesson's Student Sessions.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Class A lesson's Student Sessions section"
2. "The Student Package Order behind Student A's Math 101 Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Class A lesson's Student Sessions section"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Math 101 Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the Class A lesson's Student Sessions section"
steps_result:
1. "Student A is listed as an active student"
2. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated; Student A's imported Class Member flips to archived via the same formula"
3. "Student A no longer appears in the list"
4. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
5. "Student A reappears in the list - the same original Student Session and Class Member created by the CSV import, not newly created"
steps_data:
1. "Student A Is_Archived__c = FALSE -> shown"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Student A Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) -> hidden"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Student A Is_Archived__c = FALSE (restored) -> shown again"
